title: [REAL ATC] Air Astana has SERIOUS FLIGHT CONTROL ISSUES!
summary: Real air traffic control audio of the Air Astana flight whose flight controls had been wired in reverse by a maintenance error. The pilots struggle to keep control while ATC tries to help.
why: Linked as a primary source recording for the reversed-controls incident in aviation safety discussions.

quote.text: Amazing story about an airliner that took off not knowing its controls had been reversed
